title: Aerospace Corp executives questioned in a SCIF
summary: Eric Burles tells of Aerospace Corp executives questioned in a SCIF, about 2023-2024 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And so we we actually sent a letter early on to Aerospace Corp. um and the oversight committee um from our role from my role to be able to get them to come in and answer some questions and they actually responded and they sent um someone two people from their executive team but of course they knew nothing.

plain: A congressman named Eric Burles says that around 2023 to 2024, through his role on a congressional oversight committee, he sent a letter to Aerospace Corp, a company that does space work for the government, asking them to come answer questions. He says they sent two people from their executive team to be questioned in a SCIF, a sealed room in Washington used for discussing classified matters. According to him, the executives knew nothing, which matters because lawmakers were trying to find out whether such companies hold secrets about UFOs.
